blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements for Zscaler ITDR. To see scheduled maintenance updates for your cloud, visit the Trust Portal.

blocks.heading: Update to Amazon GuardDuty Containment Configuration

blocks.text: The command to create a role for Amazon GuardDuty containment is updated to create a common role to access the AWS account instead of a tenant-specific role.
To learn more, see Containment Configuration Guide for Amazon GuardDuty.
